summary_en: Arealink Co., Ltd. (8914) has initiated a tender offer for all issued shares of Storage King Co., Ltd. (ticker 2997), a storage facility operator with approximately 13,000 units across Tokyo and three neighboring prefectures. The acquisition is positioned as a key growth initiative to reach 200,000-unit operational capacity by 2029 through leveraging big data, customer acquisition, and operational expertise to strengthen group synergies and enterprise value.
title_en: Supplementary materials regarding notice of commencement of tender offer for Storage King Co., Ltd. shares (securities code: 2997)
translation_en_brief: Arealink Co., Ltd. (ticker 8914) has announced the initiation of a tender offer to acquire Storage King Co., Ltd. (ticker 2997). Storage King operates approximately 13,000 storage facility units primarily across Tokyo and three adjacent prefectures. The document characterizes the acquisition as a material growth initiative aligned with Arealink's mid-term management plan (2025–2027), which targets acceleration of storage business expansion. Arealink aims to reach operational management of 200,000 units by 2029 through new facility openings, partner program expansion, and strategic M&A. The tender offer is intended to unlock group synergies by applying Arealink's big data, customer acquisition capabilities, and operational expertise to enhance Storage King's efficiency and overall group enterprise value. Specific tender terms (offer price, share count, acceptance thresholds, and timeline) are not disclosed in this supplementary materials document; those details are expected to appear in the full tender offer announcement.
